name: Spicy Mexican-Style Pasta Salad with Shrimp, Corn, Pepper & Cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
3 jalapeño peppers
1 ½ limes
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ English cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Place in a large bowl.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and add to the bowl with the bell pepper. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl.

Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, jalapeño, garlic, corn, and spices; cook, stirring frequently, until veggies are soft, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp butter, unsalted
3 cups frozen corn
1 ½ tsp smoked paprika
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add shrimp to the skillet and continue to cook, stirring often, until opaque, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the shrimp are cooking, juice limes into the reserved bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl with the lime juice, along with yogurt and mayo, then stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
85 g Parmesan cheese
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and small dice cucumbers. Add to the bowl.
When the shrimp are done, add to the bowl along with the veggies and cooled pasta. Stir to combine the pasta salad.
To serve, divide the pasta salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
